description: Shipments that other companies (network connections) share with this company, read only, and open tracking requests (filter=requests). They are not the company's own shipments, so list_shipments, get_shipment and the write tools do not see them. All arguments are optional: filter (all or requests), free-text `q`. Returns: shipments[] {id, reference, ref_type, carrier, carrier_name, customer_reference, owner (@handle), owner_name, status, tracking_status, phase, eta, delay_hours, pol, pod, vessel, kind, request_status, paid_by_you, shared_at}, has_more, next_cursor. Paging: limit 1-100 (default 20) and `cursor`.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

filter.description: all (default), or requests = open tracking requests only.

q.description: Search text: reference, customer reference, container number or vessel name.

name: list_shared_shipments
title: Shipments shared with us
